physics-e2-l1.title: Vibration and transmission when sound dey produce · Basic investigation and core principle

physics-e4-l1.title: Beam balance and principle of balance · Basic investigation and core principle
physics-e4-l1.concept: To balance, di product of (weight × distance to pivot) must equal for both sides.

physics-e5-l1.title: Definition and comparison of speed · Basic investigation and core principle
physics-e5-l1.concept: Speed na di distance wey object cover for fixed time (1 second, 1 minute, 1 hour). Speed = distance covered ÷ time taken.
physics-e5-l1.example: If you run $100\text{ m}$ for $20$ seconds, di speed na $5\text{ m/s}$.

physics-e6-l1.concept: If you connect bulbs for parallel, even if one bulb go off, di other bulbs no go off. Convex lens dey gather light to one place.

physics-m1-l1.title: Gravity, friction and balance of buoyant force · Basic investigation and core principle
physics-m1-l1.concept: Di force wey Earth dey pull with na gravity ($W=mg$), di force wey dey block motion na friction, and di force wey fluid dey push up na buoyant force.
physics-m1-l1.example: Di gravity of Earth wey dey act on object wey get mass $1\text{ kg}$ na about $9.8\text{ N}$.

physics-m2-l1.concept: Current dey proportional to voltage and inversely proportional to resistance ($V=IR$). Use heat quantity $Q = c m \Delta T$ explain specific heat and temperature change.

physics-m3-l1.concept: If you apply force to object and move am, you don do work ($W=Fs$), and if no air resistance dey, di sum of potential energy and kinetic energy dey conserved.
physics-m3-l1.example: Roller coaster wey dey fall, di potential energy wey reduce dey change to kinetic energy, so di speed dey increase.

physics-h1-l1.concept: Impulse na $I = F\Delta t = \Delta p$. If you increase di collision time, di impact force go reduce. Horizontal projectile dey do free fall motion for di vertical direction.

physics-h3-l1.concept: Photoelectric effect ($E_k = hf - W$) prove say light na photon (particle) wey get energy, and de Broglie matter wave ($\lambda = h/p$) show say matter get wave property too.

physics-e1-q1.prompt: Which one of dem correct as wetin go happen if you bring North pole and South pole of magnet near each other?

options.a: Dem go pull each other
options.b: Dem go push each other comot
options.c: Notin go happen
options.d: Di colour of di magnet go change

hints: Think about wetin dey happen when different poles of magnet meet.
North pole and South pole dey like each other, so dem dey pull each other.
physics-e1-q1.explanation: For magnet, different poles (North pole and South pole) get pulling force (attraction) wey dey act between dem, while same poles get pushing force (repulsion) wey dey push dem comot.

physics-e1-q2.prompt: Dem put iron clip inside one transparent plastic cup, then dem put magnet for outside of di cup. Wetin go happen to di clip as dem dey slowly lift di magnet go up?

options.a: E go follow di magnet climb di cup wall go up
options.b: E go just stay quiet for di bottom as e dey
options.c: E go melt sharp-sharp
options.d: E go run comot from di magnet go di other side

hints: Di force of magnet fit pass through thin plastic or paper and still work.
If di magnet move, di clip go follow am.
physics-e1-q2.explanation: Magnet force (magnetic force) fit pass through thin things like plastic, paper or glass and act on things wey dem make with iron.

physics-e1-q3.prompt: Suho gather different things try stick dem for magnet as experiment. Which one of dem pair only things wey dey stick well well to magnet?

options.a: Iron nail, clip
options.b: Wooden chopsticks, plastic ruler
options.c: Rubber band, eraser
options.d: Glass marble, paper cup

hints: Look for things wey dem make with iron material.
Wood, rubber and plastic no dey stick to magnet.
physics-e1-q3.explanation: Iron nail and clip dey stick well to magnet because dem make dem with iron. Wood, rubber, plastic and glass no dey stick to magnet.

physics-e1-q4.prompt: When you close fridge door, e go click and close by itself, and e go stick tight without gap. Wetin be di science principle inside di part wey dey help am do dis?

options.a: Di pulling force of magnet inside di rubber packing
options.b: Di charging energy of electricity
options.c: Di sticky property of gum
options.d: Strong wind of air

hints: Something dey inside di soft rubber for di edge of fridge door.
E dey pull di iron body of di fridge and di door together.
physics-e1-q4.explanation: Magnetic strip dey inside di rubber packing of fridge door. E dey stick tight to di iron body of di fridge so cold air no go commot.

physics-e1-c.prompt: [Advanced investigation] If you tie string for di middle of one bar magnet, hang am for ceiling and leave am make e rest, di magnet go shake small, then e go always stop as e dey point one particular direction. Wetin be di reason?

options.a: Because di Earth itself na giant magnet
options.b: Because wind dey blow from north only
options.c: Because sunlight dey pull di magnet
options.d: Because air weight heavy pass for south

hints: E be like di principle wey make compass always point north and south.
Di Earth wey we dey live on na big magnet wey get North Pole and South Pole.
physics-e1-c.explanation: Di Earth na giant magnet wey get South pole property near North Pole and North pole property near South Pole, so North pole of magnet wey fit move freely go point north, while South pole go point south.

physics-e1-q5.prompt: If you cut bar magnet for di middle into two pieces, wetin go happen to di two ends of di cut magnet?

options.a: Each cut piece of magnet go get new North pole and South pole again
options.b: E go divide into one magnet wey get only North pole and one wey get only South pole
options.c: E go lose magnet property completely and just become iron
options.d: Both pieces go get only North pole

hints: No matter how small you cut magnet, North pole and South pole go always dey as pair.
Magnet wey get only one pole no dey.
physics-e1-q5.explanation: For magnet, di magnetic moments for atom level dey arrange well, so no matter how small you cut am, new North pole and South pole go always form again as pair for each piece.

physics-e2-q1.prompt: Dem hit tuning fork with rubber hammer, then dem touch am small for water surface inside tank. Which one be di correct thing wey go happen?

options.a: Di water go splash everywhere because di tuning fork dey vibrate
options.b: Ice go form inside di water
options.c: Di tuning fork go absorb di water
options.d: Di water go start to boil

If something wey dey vibrate fast touch water, ripples go form.
physics-e2-q1.explanation: Tuning fork wey dey make sound dey vibrate, so as e touch water, e go splash di water everywhere and create waves.

physics-e2-q2.prompt: When people dey talk with 'string telephone' wey dem make from two paper cups and silk thread, which method go make di other person voice clear pass?

options.a: Pull di string tight before you talk
options.b: Leave di string loose
options.c: Hold di middle of di string tight with hand
options.d: Soak di string well well with water

hints: Sound dey travel through di vibration of di string.
If you hold di string with hand or e loose, di vibration go stop.
physics-e2-q2.explanation: For string telephone, di vibration from di bottom of di paper cup dey pass through di string, so di string must tight make di vibration fit reach di other side well.

physics-e2-q3.prompt: Dem put plenty rice grains on top big drum and hit di drum with drumstick softly and hard. Which statement correct as comparison?

options.a: Di harder you hit, di higher di rice grains go jump and di louder di sound go be
options.b: Di softer you hit, di higher di rice grains go jump
options.c: Even if you hit hard, di height of di rice grains no go change
options.d: If you hit di drum hard, di vibration of di sound go stop

hints: If you hit with big force, di drum skin go vibrate more.
Di bigger di size of di vibration (amplitude), di louder di sound.
physics-e2-q3.explanation: Di harder you hit di drum, di bigger di size of vibration (amplitude) of di drum skin, so di rice grains go jump higher and di sound go louder.

physics-e2-q4.prompt: Dem put candle for front of one speaker wey dey play music loud, and di candle flame dey shake follow di beat of di music. Wetin cause dis thing?

options.a: Because di vibration from di speaker make di air vibrate
options.b: Because only hot heat come out from di speaker
options.c: Because light pour out from di speaker
options.d: Because di wick of di candle melt

hints: Di speaker diaphragm dey vibrate front and back, so e dey push and pull di air around am.
Di vibration of di air reach di candle.
physics-e2-q4.explanation: Di diaphragm of di speaker dey vibrate and make di air vibrate, and dis air vibration (sound wave) reach di candle flame and make am shake.

physics-e2-c.prompt: [Advanced thinking] Dem put alarm clock inside vacuum glass jar wey dem don comot all di air from, then dem make di alarm ring. Di clock hammer dey shake and dey hit di bell but dem no hear any sound at all. Wetin be di reason?

options.a: Because no air (medium) dey to carry di sound
options.b: Because sound dey change to light inside vacuum
options.c: Because di glass wall absorb all di sound
options.d: Because di vibration of di clock don too fast

hints: For sound to reach our ear, e need something wey go carry am like air.
Vacuum no get any gas molecule at all.
physics-e2-c.explanation: Sound dey travel through vibration of material (medium) like air, so for vacuum wey no get air, sound no fit travel.

physics-e2-q5.prompt: When you hit xylophone keys, which one be di correct comparison of how high or low di sound dey for short key and long key?

options.a: Di shorter di key, di faster e dey vibrate, so di sound go high
options.b: Di longer di key, di higher di sound
options.c: Length of key and how high or low di sound no get any connection
options.d: Short key no dey make sound at all

hints: Di shorter and thinner di object, di faster e dey vibrate for one second.
Di more di frequency, di higher di sound note.
physics-e2-q5.explanation: Di shorter di key, di more times di object dey vibrate for one second (frequency), so di sound go high. Di longer di key, di less di frequency, so di sound go low.

physics-e3-q1.prompt: If dem put three paper boards wey get holes side by side for front of torch light, how you must arrange di holes so dat you fit see di light from di other side?

options.a: Arrange am so dat di three holes dey for one straight line
options.b: Put di three holes zigzag, one no face di other
options.c: Di place of di holes no matter, put dem anyhow
options.d: Cover di hole of di middle paper board with tape

Light get di property to travel straight (straight-line travel).
physics-e3-q1.explanation: Light get di property to travel straight (straight-line travel of light), so light fit pass through all di holes only when di three holes dey for one straight line.

physics-e3-q2.prompt: You wan make di shadow of teddy bear wey show for screen bigger pass how e dey now. Which method correct?

options.a: Bring di teddy bear closer to di torch
options.b: Bring di teddy bear closer to di screen
options.c: Move di torch back far away from di teddy bear
options.d: Reduce di light of di torch make e weak

hints: Di closer di object dey to where di light start from, di wider di area wey e dey block light.
Try put di object close to di torch.
physics-e3-q2.explanation: Di closer di distance between light source (torch) and object, di bigger di angle wey di object dey cover light, so di size of di shadow for screen go big.

physics-e3-q3.prompt: Dem shine torch on three objects (transparent glass plate, oil paper, thick black cardboard) and observe di shadow wey form for wall. Which object dey make di darkest and clearest shadow?

options.a: Thick black cardboard
options.b: Transparent glass plate
options.c: Oil paper
options.d: All di three objects na di same

Most light dey pass through glass plate, so shadow hardly dey form.
physics-e3-q3.explanation: Thick black cardboard na opaque object wey almost no allow light pass, so e block light completely and make di darkest shadow.

physics-e3-q4.prompt: Dem observe di shadow of flagpole wey stand for school field for sunny day. For morning and evening di shadow long well well, and for 12 noon di shadow shortest. Wetin be di reason?

options.a: Because di altitude (height) of di sun highest for 12 noon
options.b: Because sunlight speed dey increase for daytime
options.c: Because di flagpole length dey increase for morning
options.d: Because wind dey blow di shadow push am

physics-e3-c.prompt: [Advanced investigation] Dem look candle through 'pinhole camera' wey dem make by drilling small pinhole for di front of one box and put translucent paper for di back, and di image of di candle form upside down and left-right reversed. options.b: Because light dey reflect and bend inside di pinhole

options.d: Because di lens dey absorb di light

Draw di straight path of di light with line.

physics-e3-q5.prompt: For dark room, you shine torch light on smooth flat mirror. Which property of light dey show?

options.b: Light dey absorb inside di mirror and disappear
options.c: Light dey pass through di mirror go straight reach di wall for di other side
options.d: Light dey break into many parts and become rainbow

Di angle of incidence and di angle of reflection dey equal.

physics-e4-q1.prompt: For one beam balance, dem hang 20 g weight for 4 marks to di left of di pivot. How much weight must dem hang for 2 marks to di right of di pivot to make am level?

physics-e4-q2.prompt: One elder brother wey weigh 40 kg and one younger sibling wey weigh 20 kg dey play seesaw. How dem must sit to balance and enjoy am?

options.b: Di elder brother go sit farther from di pivot pass di younger sibling

physics-e4-q3.prompt: For balance experiment, dem hang two 10 g weights for 3 marks to di left of di pivot. How many 10 g weights dem need to hang for 1 mark to di right to make am level?
